facts.fact: Phil 在窗框夹层捡到一张掉落的折纸，展开后认出笔迹属于 Anne Bredon（凭房间里留下的教案辨认）；纸条上是一句拉丁文与一段英文备注。
facts.anchor: The handwriting was that of Anne Bredon

facts.fact: 同校教师 Mr Smithson 敲门进入 Phil 的房间，问她为何不在 staff room 批作业，并提议彼此直呼 Phil 与 Jeffrey。
facts.anchor: I may call you Phil, I hope? Do call me Jeffrey.

facts.fact: 在 Broken Bramble 酒吧，Hamish Matthews 自我介绍，说自己在私营公司 Mediconatural Information Services 做 health informatics（病人管理系统）。
facts.anchor: I work for a private corporation, Mediconatural Information Services.

facts.fact: Jane Worth 走进酒吧，把 Phil 从桌边带走，并说自己是 Head 派来接她回去的人。
facts.anchor: She was the one who sent me to collect you

facts.fact: Jane 在店外断定 Hamish 是 Department for Education（教育部）派来查 Grayne's 的间谍，并说要向 Head 汇报。
facts.anchor: obviously a spy from the Department for Education

facts.fact: Phil 假装看向门口，故意把杯里的苹果酒泼翻在 Hamish 的裤子上，随后借机跟 Jane 离开。
Phil 进入酒吧时，店里有 a dozen people 散在吧台与桌边喝酒，角落的飞镖盘还有人在玩。
facts.anchor: a dozen people were scattered around

facts.fact: Phil 在镇上用手机给亲友发了几条短信，包括两位爱传闲话的 great-aunts 和一位关心教育事务的 cousin。
facts.anchor: had sent several texts to friends and family
